timing: Cash paid on the spot after in-store evaluation; no appointment needed.
who_pays: Play It Again Sports - the store pays you directly on the spot, in cash or store credit.
who_qualifies: You must own the gear and be able to visit a Play It Again Sports store in person. No appointment needed.
work_available: Yes - stores were buying on the spot as of 2026-09-23, no appointment needed. But they only buy gear in current demand: out-of-season or overstocked items get declined.
what_gets_accepted: Staff evaluate condition, brand, sport-season demand, and what the store already stocks. Bring gear that is in current demand; cash pays less than trade credit.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees; no shipping since you bring gear in. Your unpaid time is the trip - no appointment needed, so you can hit two locations the same day and take the better offer.
when_cash_arrives: Real cash on the spot after in-store evaluation - or typically higher trade credit toward store product.
